name: apply_damage
description: Applies damage to a character or NPC, automatically applying the target's resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities when damage_type is provided. Resistance halves damage (round down); immunity negates it; vulnerability doubles it. Temporary HP absorbs damage after this multiplier is applied. HP cannot go below 0. Always pass the raw dice roll — do not pre-adjust for resistances.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the character or NPC to damage.

amount.description: The raw damage amount before resistances (i.e., the dice roll total). Do not halve or double it — the server applies the correct multiplier.

damage_type.description: The type of damage (e.g., Fire, Slashing, Necrotic). Must match the values stored in the target's damage_resistances, damage_immunities, or damage_vulnerabilities. If omitted, no multiplier is applied.
